effect_descriptions.undergarden:brittleness: The higher the victim's armor value is, the more damage they will take. Amount of damage received scales with potion level.
effect_descriptions.undergarden:chilly: Slows the victim down and causes them to visually shake.
effect_descriptions.undergarden:featherweight: When damaged, victim will receive increased knockback. Amount of knockback scales with potion level.
effect_descriptions.undergarden:gooey: Scintling Goo will constantly be placed under victim's feet.
effect_descriptions.undergarden:purity: Reduces the amount of Utheric Infection an entity has per second. Amount removed scales with potion level.
effect_descriptions.undergarden:virulence: Similar to poison, but does more damage at a slower rate. Damage is suppressed by Virulent Resistance.
